current.text: He is the projected starter for the Lakers at about 30 minutes a game. The experts are fairly confident about it.
Andy expects him to start because he is the team's best point of attack defender and can also score and handle the ball.
LeBron James left the Lakers. Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves are the remaining core.
He is a high-end late flyer. On his own his best case is about top 110.
If Doncic or Reaves misses time, he becomes the second option and could have a top 70 to 80 run. That makes him a handcuff who also has value on his own.
Doncic's health is seen as a weak point for the Lakers.
The Lakers play 3, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. That is in the bottom half of the league.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league.

note: He sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool (Yahoo rank 134 at about 1 USD, ESPN rank 119 at 2 USD, and he was not drafted in our league). That makes him a 1 USD final pick at most, or a waiver add. He has no weak category, so he fits any build. He is most useful to the manager who owns Doncic or Reaves, because he could be a top 70 to 80 player if either one misses time. Early in the season, check that he starts and plays about 30 minutes. Also watch his FG% (about 45% projected). The weak playoff schedule (3-4-3) and many back-to-backs limit his late-season appeal.
